question: Which of the following is an autobiography of Abul Kalam Azad, the first education minister of India?

options.text: The Story of My Experiments with Truth

solution:
The correct answer is __**India Wins Freedom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **India Wins Freedom** is the autobiography of Abul Kalam Azad, the first Education Minister of independent India.
 
• The book offers a detailed account of India's struggle for independence and Azad's role as a leader of the Indian National Congress.
 
• It provides insights into key political and social developments, including the partition of India and the challenges faced during nation-building.
 
• Abul Kalam Azad was a staunch advocate of Hindu-Muslim unity and played a significant role in shaping modern India's education policy.
 
• The autobiography was published posthumously in 1959 and remains a crucial source for understanding India's independence movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abul Kalam Azad**

 
 
• Born on November 11, 1888, in Mecca, Azad was a freedom fighter, scholar, and senior leader of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He became the first Minister of Education in independent India and emphasized universal primary education and education for women.
 
• In his honor, November 11 is celebrated as National Education Day in India.
 
 
 
• **Contributions to Education**
 
 
• Azad helped establish institutions like IITs, the University Grants Commission (UGC), and the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR).
 
• He laid the foundation for Sahitya Akademi and promoted cultural and educational advancements in India.
 
 
 
• **Other Related Works**
 
 
• **The Story of My Experiments with Truth:** Autobiography of Mahatma Gandhi, focusing on his life philosophy and political journey.
 
• **My Country My Life:** Autobiography of L.K. Advani, documenting his political career and contributions to the BJP.
 
• **Long Walk to Freedom:** Autobiography of Nelson Mandela, chronicling his fight against apartheid in South Africa.
 
 
 
• **India Wins Freedom**
 
 
• The book provides a personal perspective on India’s freedom struggle, including Azad's views on the partition and its impact.
 
• It is considered an essential resource for understanding the political dynamics of pre-independence India.
